title: rn-dev project config
description: Shape exported by a project's `rn-dev.config.ts`. Validated at session boot by the daemon.

hooks.description: Map keyed on '<moduleId>/<hookName>'. Values are HookEntry registrations.

allowModuleOverrides.description: Module IDs whose registrations against '<id>/custom' the project opts in to (security gate, H5).

allowModuleHardFails.description: Module IDs whose `onFail: 'hard'` registrations against non-override slots the project opts in to (security gate, H5).

hookEntry.description: Sugar form: a string is shorthand for { script: <string> }. Object forms are discriminated by the presence of `script` or `fn`.

fn.description: In-process function. JSON Schema cannot type-check this; the daemon validates that it is callable at config-load.
